top_only:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a minimal design variation of this exact supplied round two-tier maple side table. Keep identical image camera, crop, background, lighting, scale, BOTH round disc sizes/heights, solid cream MAPLE surfaces and their plain maple circular edges, four arch-crown maple blade legs, walnut-lined long leg slots, walnut foot shoes, and three tightly stacked horizontal walnut X supports beneath the lower shelf. Do NOT add walnut to the circular outer rims. No veneer, no metal handles, no props/text.
New feature: a SMALL NARROW RECTANGULAR THROUGH-HOLE exactly at the CENTRE of the specified round tabletop, long axis running left-right across the table in world space. Its four straight sides framed by a thin natural WALNUT inlay/lipping approximately 5mm wide, FLUSH with the tabletop surface, clean square mitred corners; walnut also lines the inner vertical cut walls. After the trim, the remaining OPEN AIR aperture is approximately 110mm long x30mm wide for a hand-grip-sized opening. These are indicative concept proportions, not printed dimensions. Hole is small relative to the approximately600mm table diameter. No raised handle, no filled black rectangle, no walnut solid inset, no huge letterbox. Show true cut depth, an open void and physically appropriate shadows. Subtle corner easing permitted for touch but visual contour remains rectangular, NOT a capsule. Neutral ivory maple, subdued fine grain; warm dark walnut trim matching the leg-slot vocabulary. Whole table fully visible. This is visual exploration, not a load-tested carrying handle. Preserve the original support system even if it would obstruct a hand beneath the lower centre opening; do not erase X beams to invent clearance.
VARIANT 1: Add EXACTLY ONE walnut-framed rectangular through-hole, at the centre of the UPPER/LARGER tabletop ONLY. The lower/smaller circular shelf must remain completely plain solid maple with NO hole, NO dark inlay and NO handle.
